messages:
andre: Quick heads-up — Perf CI shows a regression for seqlen=4096 after the KV-stripe layout change. Flamegraphs attached in CI, but short summary: MQA path falling back to a slower paged-attn kernel because of cache misalignment on certain block sizes.

maya: Saw the CI alert. Is it deterministic? Can you share a repro command?

andre: Repro script (local perf harness):
```
./bench/profiler --model=gqa-22B --seq=4096 --batch=4 --kv-layout=stripe_v2 --runs=5
```
Baseline vs current: ~+12% token-ms on Ampere. Flame snippet shows heavy time in `kv_load -> memcpy -> kernel_paginate` (dominating).

linh: Any arch differences (A100 vs H100)?

andre: H100 shows smaller delta (~+4%) but A100 is the worst. Hypothesis: selector picks blocksz=128 for stripe_v2; when seq % blocksz != 0 we enter a fragment path that performs atomic merges / scalar leftovers. That kills coalescing.

sam: Can we short-term force tiled-kv for MQA on seqlen > 2048 as a mitigation?

maya: We can, but it hides the root cause. Where is the alignment check in code? I can add targeted logs.

andre: It's in `runtime/kernels/kv_layout_picker.cc` around the heuristic function. It uses avg_seqlen/avg_block heuristics. I'll push a quick branch with extra coverage and a unit test.

ci-bot: Perf CI: regression detected in job 2765432109-seqlen-hysteresis (baseline 1.03s -> PR 1.15s) :rotating_light: Full report: https://ci.internal/2765432109

linh: I also saw GPU memory traffic spike in traces — KV fetches increased due to non-coalesced loads when block boundaries are misaligned. Suspect page offsets when blocksz != 256.

sam: Proposed mitigation: add hysteresis to kernel selector so brief telemetry blips don't flip to the paged variant immediately. That should reduce oscillation and regression surface during bursty tails.

maya: +1. Also suggest adding a seqlen histogram probe to the Console (per-model) so ops can tune batcher thresholds instead of guessing.

andre: For autotune, we should run an offline microbench that samples candidate kernels with the model's seqlen distribution and outputs a per-(model,arch,kv-layout) kernel profile. That gives deterministic picks instead of heuristics.

ops-bot: Note: rolling canary enabled for kernel-selector v2 on dedicated cluster `redwood-ded-2`. Monitor token-ms and memory-bandwidth dashboards.

sam: I'll draft a PR: (1) hysteresis window (ms), (2) forced tiled fallback for MQA when seqlen>2048 + odd-block detection, (3) unit tests asserting selector behavior. Example pseudo-test: `assert(select_kernel(4096, stripe_v2, H100) != paged)`

maya: Add config flag `runtime.kernelselector.hysteresis_ms` default 30000 and a sampling rate `runtime.kernelselector.sample_rate=0.01` for autotune probes.

andre: Action items: sam -> open PR for hysteresis + fallback; maya -> instrument seqlen hist probe to Console; linh -> run microbench across A100/H100 for stripe_v2 with blocksz in {64,128,256} and post flamegraphs. I'll run repro and attach traces to the PR.

sam: Will open PR today and tag @andre for review. :thumbsup:

maya: One more ask — add a small CLI to the profiler to emit `kv-offsets.csv` (per-request offsets) so we can correlate misaligned requests with perf.

andre: Good idea. If we can correlate offsets -> kernel choice -> perf delta we can make autotuner safe to deploy.

linh: I'll start the A100 sweep now and drop results in this thread.

ci-bot: Reminder: Perf regression alert will auto-close when a verified mitigation PR lands and CI confirms baseline parity.

sam: tagging this as P0 for runtime perf.
